name: TDspMidiPlayer
description: Synth-agnostic MIDI file player: runtime SMF parser + non-blocking sequencer that drives a tdsp::MidiSink. Backend (Dexed / ymfm / ...) is chosen on the sink side.
//: Depends on the TDspMidi library (tdsp::MidiSink). Resolved locally by PlatformIO LDF include-scanning of lib_extra_dirs; not declared here to avoid a registry lookup on the local-only name.
